Scott's 2017 bridge from Prometheus toward the xenomorph.

How Alien: Covenant connects

  • Creator: Ridley Scott — Scott directed Alien: Covenant.
  • Topic: Alien — Alien: Covenant continues the prequel path.
  • Character: David — Covenant turns on David's xenomorph experiments.
  • Work: Prometheus — Covenant follows Prometheus toward the xenomorph.

What is Alien: Covenant?

Alien: Covenant follows the colony ship Covenant into David's experiments, tightening the prequel line toward the classic xenomorph.
